title: Paper Signals
designThesis: A restrained paper ground gives the oversized headline authority while small technical labels provide contrast.
designBrief: Lead with a large serif headline, use a disciplined grid, and reserve monospaced labels for useful metadata. Avoid ornamental dashboard panels.
imageRecipe: [SUBJECT] on a warm paper ground, fine grain texture, high contrast, generous negative space, restrained rust accent.
assetBrief: Use high-contrast cutout imagery with a subtle paper treatment.

palette: Warm paper, near-black, and one rust accent
typography: Oversized serif display paired with tiny monospaced labels
texture: Fine grain across the paper ground
